summary: Host Digital Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amendment correcting the name of an underwriter (Muriel Siebert Co., LLC, previously misidentified as Siebert Williams Shank Co., LLC) in a prior supplement covering 2,187,500 Class A common shares. No new securities, pricing, or deal terms are introduced; the underlying offering was a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Cantor is lead book-running manager, with Siebert, A.G.P., and Clear Street as joint book-running managers. The amendment does not modify the offering itself; no arbitrage angle applies.
